# Outlook Luxe

> > India's premier luxury lifestyle destination covering high-end fashion, fine dining, exclusive travel, watches, art, and design.

Outlook Luxe is the luxury vertical of Outlook India, offering curated content on premium experiences across fashion, travel, food, watches, jewellery, art, and design. The publication features expert insights from industry leaders, designers, and tastemakers, with a focus on both Indian heritage craftsmanship and global luxury trends.

## Key Topics

- Luxury Travel & Resorts
- Fine Dining & Indian Cuisine
- Designer Fashion & Couture
- Luxury Watches & Watchmaking
- Indian Textiles & Weaves
- Art Fairs & Exhibitions
- Designer Accessories & Bags
- Skincare & Beauty Trends
- Heritage Craftsmanship
- Silent Luxury
- Wedding Experiences
- Emily In Paris Collaborations
- FDCI India Men's Weekend
- India Art Fair
- Premium Hospitality
